title: fancy-cli project config (fancy.json)
description: The fancy.json that `npx fancy-cli@latest init` writes at a project's root. Every field is optional: the CLI uses its default for anything omitted. Reference: https://ui.particle.academy/docs/cli

registry.description: The registry origin components and nodes are fetched from.

components.description: The import alias for the components directory, e.g. `@/components/fancy`.

utils.description: The import alias for shared utilities, e.g. `@/lib/utils`.

rsc.description: Whether the project uses React Server Components.

css.description: The Tailwind v4 stylesheet a component extends when it ships CSS.

components.description: Where component files are written on disk. Derived from `aliases.components` when omitted.

flowNodes.description: Where a workflow node's TypeScript (its UI and JS backend) is written. Defaults to `<components>/flow-nodes`.

flowNodesPhp.description: Where a workflow node's PHP backend is written. Defaults to `app/Flow/Nodes`.
